meta.title: Novi Sad airport transfers | Ćomitrans
meta.description: Private transfers from Novi Sad to Belgrade, Budapest, Timișoara, Osijek and Zagreb airports. A Ford Galaxy for up to four passengers, from your door to the terminal.

hero.title: From your door to the airport.
hero.lead: Private transfers from your door to wherever you need to go.
hero.also: I also drive to Budapest, Timișoara, Osijek and Zagreb airports.
hero.photo: Ćomi standing next to his Ford Galaxy

airport.title: Airport transfers
airport.lead: One message is enough. You tell me when and where from, I reply with the price and the pickup time.

steps.title: Send the details
steps.text: Date, flight time, address and number of passengers. A call, WhatsApp or Viber all work.

steps.title: Get a confirmation
steps.text: I reply with the price and the pickup time, allowing for traffic and check-in.

steps.title: I pick you up
steps.text: At your address, at the agreed time. Luggage goes in the boot, you take your seat.

steps.title: You arrive at the terminal
steps.text: I drop you at the departures entrance.

steps.title: Send your flight number
steps.text: Along with the date, the address and the number of passengers.

steps.title: I follow your flight
steps.text: I time the pickup to the actual landing, so a late plane is not your problem.

steps.title: I wait at arrivals
steps.text: Message me once you have your bags and we meet outside the exit.

steps.title: I drive you to your door
steps.text: To your address in Novi Sad or nearby.

routes.title: Airports I drive to
routes.lead: Pickup is at your address in Novi Sad or nearby. Distances and times are approximate. For airports abroad, allow for the border crossing too.
routes.other: Your route is not on the board?
routes.otherAction: Tell me where from and where to

rides.title: Not just airports
rides.lead: Same car, same driver, other routes.

intercity.title: Intercity and cross-border rides
intercity.text: Address to address, with no changes and no waiting at stations. We cross the border together.

events.title: Events and nights out
events.text: I take you to the wedding, concert or party and bring you home when it ends, so nobody in the group has to drive.

trips.title: Day trips
trips.text: A day on Fruška Gora, a round of wineries or a visit to a spa. I wait until you are ready to head back.

cargo.title: Small cargo
cargo.text: A parcel, documents or anything that fits in the Galaxy with the seats folded. It is not a van, but it holds more than you would think.

vehicle.title: Ford Galaxy: four comfortable seats for you
vehicle.lead: One seat is mine, the other four are yours. Pick how many of you are travelling and see where you sit.
vehicle.note: The boot is large. If you are bringing more than the usual luggage, let me know in advance.

about.title: I'm Ćomi.
text: Ćomitrans is one driver and one Galaxy. I answer your call myself, come to pick you up and drive you to your destination.
No dispatcher and no surprises: you know who is waiting for you and in which car.
about.plate: A licence plate reading NS ĆOMI

items.q: How do I book a ride?
items.a: Call, or message me on WhatsApp or Viber. The quickest way is the form at the bottom of this page: fill in the details and the message writes itself.

items.q: How far ahead should I book?
items.a: The earlier the better, especially for early morning flights and weekends. Do get in touch at the last minute too: if I am free, I drive.

items.q: What if my flight is late?
items.a: Send me your flight number. I follow the landing time and arrive when the plane actually lands.
The boot is large. If you are bringing more than the usual luggage, let me know in advance.
We agree the price before the ride, and you pay when we set off.

items.q: Do you drive at night and on holidays?
items.a: Yes. Flights do not keep office hours, and neither do I.

items.q: Do you drive to other cities and airports?
items.a: Yes. If your route is not listed, tell me where from and where to and I will reply with a price.

booking.title: Book a ride
booking.lead: Fill in what you know. The message writes itself as you type, and you choose how to send it.

status.viber: Message copied. If it does not appear in Viber, paste it in.

booking.privacy: Nothing you type is sent from this page. The message is put together on your device and you send it yourself.
booking.noscript: The form needs JavaScript. You can call or write directly:

message.greeting: Hello Ćomi, I would like to book a ride.
message.subject: Ride
message.name: Name

footer.privacy: No cookies and no tracking. This site collects no data.
